lanes.0: Request prepared-Control, tags and ordered Data/BE
lanes.1: Response prepared-Control, tags and ordered Data/BE

interface_contract: external producer queues hold each unacknowledged header/tag/data entry stable
each prepared Control contains only its own Request or Response fields and NOP padding
each Data/BE source is ordered according to headers in its own class; storage of these transmit queues is not in this module
pending, shared/done, available/capacity and Tx catch budgets come from the same actual credit port
only actual wire o_tx_taken drives i_taken
Auth configuration stable throughout reset epoch; upstream supplies correct tags; cryptography not implemented here
Data tenure >1 eventually receives two available halves; final tail needs one; arbitrary FIFO-depth/source-gap liveness remains open
policy: prefer fully eligible class over blocked opposite class
then consider a credit-funded class needing catch-budget NOP
round robin between equal-priority classes, updated only on actual header transmission
hold chosen header class under output stall
old Data/BE owner remains separate from the new header class until the actual event
diagnostics: o_header_error independently flags invalid or wrong-class prepared headers
o_capacity_shortfall independently identifies total-capacity insufficiency without consuming or discarding that head
open: actual transmit FIFO queues and SRAM payload buffers
per-VC queue independence and complete scheduling proof
oversized transaction completion and UPLI semantics
process STA and full Endpoint/Switch integration
